ROSTER-ONLY retint of the ruin_warden rig at seal scale (:401's distinct-id-per-context contract: no per-encounter stat or AI override exists, so a new context takes a NEW ID, never a shared one re-tuned). Same sprite, same melee profile, same tough_body spine as ruin_guardian. Fought SOLO by design, which is why the con/die curve sits under vault_construct's party-scaled 190/15. Tuned against sim_combat_batch's seal_warden_t5_sw14_solo gated cell. MEASURED at authoring (100 seeds, spellsword14 solo): win 0.59, median 5 rounds (3-7) -- the hardest solo cell in the game at that build, against the forge golem's 0.71 and the market watchgolems' 0.88. Deliberately HIGH-con/LOW-die: a ward outlasts you rather than bursting you down. combat_scale 1.15 is ruin_guardian's own (at 1.35 the rig's head clipped under the combat HUD banner).
